_what_this_is: The rulings behind build/guide-pre1950-delimited.json: how its printed labels are read, what is held out, and why the file is now a store in the read model. Until 2026-09-13 this file explained why it was NOT one; that record is kept below as history.

COVERED_BY_THE_GENERAL_LABEL_RULING.ruling: The general label ruling (declarations/readings.json RULING: a printed label may be mapped to a field; map only the unambiguous; leave the rest as printed and count it) covers this file. The 7 September red was waiting on 'a ruling on label to field mapping for this file's vocabulary', and that ruling has been made.
COVERED_BY_THE_GENERAL_LABEL_RULING.the_mapped_labels: The labels readings.json LABELS maps (665 claims: height, weight, birth date, hometown, college, high school in their printed spellings) are read into their fields at read time, with the printed string kept.
COVERED_BY_THE_GENERAL_LABEL_RULING.the_rest: Every other label -- 876 person labels and 11 OCR-damaged ones (guide.Aye, guide.A ge, Cracral Information and the like) -- stays exactly as printed and is counted in the file's labels_left_as_printed.
COVERED_BY_THE_GENERAL_LABEL_RULING.the_shape: Rewritten into the normal store shape, in its writer (src/ingest_guide_delimited.py), not taught to the reader: a reader that looks for nested claims would start reading any report that happens to carry them, which is the silent failure RS-G5 exists to catch. The claims sit at the top level beside a source_records table; each guide's source declaration is carried in `sources`.

derived_birth_year_range.ruling: The 74 derived birth-year ranges stay, as a derived READING. The printed age stays as the claim; the range sits beside it, on that claim, as `_derived_birth_year_range` -- labelled derived, naming the age it came from and the guide's year -- and it is never a claim from the source. Same shape as same_day for dates, and the same rule the context document states: a check, never a correction.
derived_birth_year_range.was: a claim of its own, predicate derived.BIRTH_YEAR_RANGE, kind derived.

held_out_labels._ruled: Ryan, 2026-09-13: they stay out, as proposed. Listed in the file's held_out with the person, the value and the reason; never claimed.

_history_THE_RED_WAS_CORRECT_2026_09_07.what_failed: The read service's G5 failed on this file: 1,653 claims over 238 people from 32 guides, none of them in the read model.
_history_THE_RED_WAS_CORRECT_2026_09_07.leave_it_failing: Do not declare it away and do not ingest it to clear it. An unexplained red gets fixed by someone in a hurry; this file existed so the red was explained and the hurry had somewhere to stop.
_history_THE_RED_WAS_CORRECT_2026_09_07.what_would_clear_it_honestly: A ruling from Ryan on label to field mapping for this file's vocabulary -- not an ingest, and not an entry in the read service's build-files.json. CLEARED 2026-09-13 by exactly that: see COVERED_BY_THE_GENERAL_LABEL_RULING.
_history_THE_RED_WAS_CORRECT_2026_09_07.not_superseded_by_the_corpus: guide-prose-corpus covers the same documents but extracts only guide.prose_block and guide.vitals_as_printed -- 38 claims from pre-1950 guides against this file's 1,653. Declaring this file away as superseded would have dropped about 1,600 claims.
_history_THE_RED_WAS_CORRECT_2026_09_07.the_nested_shape_was_a_one_off: Fetching's sweep of all 1,146 build files (2026-09-07) found this the only file holding claims below the top level. Since 2026-09-13 there is none.

WHAT_THE_BIOS_TAKE_FROM_IT.read_by: src/bio_select.py, as a required input via required('build','guide-pre1950-delimited.json') -- the top-level claims since 2026-09-13, with each guide's title and year from `sources`.
WHAT_THE_BIOS_TAKE_FROM_IT.fields: The six labels mapped in declarations/readings.json (height, weight, birth_date_as_printed, hometown, college, high_school), plus guide.NOTES* for the bio close and guide.SERVICE RECORD / guide.MARITAL STATUS.
WHAT_THE_BIOS_TAKE_FROM_IT.the_panel_is_honest_about_it: Every panel value names its source, so a guide value is labelled 'guide' and sits beside the archive's own.
